content.title: How to watch Mets vs. Cardinals: TV channel and streaming options for April 1
content.text: The New York Mets and St. Louis Cardinals play on Wednesday at 1:15 p.m. ET at Busch Stadium, attempting to break a 1-1 series tie. Freddy Peralta (1-0, 7.20 ERA) gets the start for the Mets, who are 3-2 this season and third in the NL East. Matthew Liberatore (0-0, 1.80 ERA) is the expected starter for the Cardinals, who are 3-2 and third in the NL Central.How to watch New York Mets vs. St. Louis Cardinals Venue: Busch Stadium Time: 1:15 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: Cardinals.TV and SNY Watching in person?
